summary: Shuttle Pharmaceuticals Holdings, Inc. filed Form 8-K reporting its acquisition of United Dogecoin Inc. via a merger. The merger was completed on May 6, 2026, with Shuttle's wholly owned subsidiary merging into United Dogecoin, which survived as a direct subsidiary. Consideration was stock-based: each share of Existing Company Common Stock was canceled and converted into a portion of the Merger Consideration (exact value not disclosed). The board of registrant recommended the transaction. Regulatory clock started upon Delaware certificate of merger filing. Watch for disclosure of exchange ratio to calculate premium and any shareholder dissent or appraisal rights.
